notes.title: The Lab - Escape Room Demo is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We welcome the Steam Next Fest 2022! And now The Lab - Escape Room Demo is out!

You can play the first part of our game, trying to solve the mistery of The Lab while solving puzzles and discovering amazing things! Steam Next Fest will end in 20th June so hurry up!

[h1]Download the demo here![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1960930/The_Lab__Escape_Room/
